name: Now playing
description: What your Mac is playing, in the sidebar, in a tab and on a page: every app playing at once (Spotify, Music, a browser tab), each with its cover, the song and artist and how far in, with play, pause, skip and shuffle, and the volume. Only on the Mac the app's server runs on.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: What the user's Mac is playing (every app at once), and play, pause, skip or volume: `now-playing.get`, `now-playing.control`.

now-playing.description: what this mac is playing, every app at once, with covers, position, controls and volume
now-playing.live: macOS's now playing (MediaRemote) on the server's machine
